title: Engineering Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $8,500 - $10,000 USD


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure role is designed to own the technical systems responsible for money movement across their organization. At our partner, payments are not a support function. They are core product infrastructure. They advance funds to lab clients based on AI-driven claim valuation, reconcile against real insurance adjudication data, and manage complex settlement flows that must balance to the penny.


As transaction volume scales into hundreds of millions annually, the complexity of reliability, reconciliation, auditability, and compliance increases materially. This role exists to ensure they scale financial infrastructure with rigor, precision, and long-term architectural clarity. This is a player-coach leadership role, initially hands-on, evolving into team leadership and architectural stewardship of a dedicated payments engineering pod.


This role is accountable for:

  • Technical ownership of payment infrastructure and settlement systems
  • Reliability and correctness of all financial flows
  • Ledger and reconciliation architecture
  • Cross-team coordination for finance-critical systems
  • Building and leading a dedicated payments engineering pod


Key Responsibilities:


Payment Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own systems that disburse client advances, execute Treasury sweeps, process lockbox deposits, and generate settlement payments
  • Ensure all transactions reconcile precisely and remain fully auditable
  • Implement idempotency, monitoring, alerting, retry logic, and failure handling for payment-critical flows
  • Design workflows resilient to bank outages, ACH return codes, NSF events, and timing mismatches
  • Establish zero-error tolerance standards as volume scales


Ledger & Reconciliation Architecture

  • Design and evolve the internal ledger system tracking each receivable lifecycle from claim valuation to advance to adjudication to sweep to final settlement
  • Build reconciliation engines matching Payment Advances to ERA data
  • Automate weekly settlement calculations, including true-ups, clawbacks, and offsets
  • Ensure economic logic for Qualified vs. Non-Qualified claims is correctly implemented
  • Maintain strict auditability and financial traceability across systems


Cross-Team Collaboration & Platform Integration

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Data, Billing, and Clinical Platform teams
  • Ensure payment systems integrate cleanly with claim processing, ERA ingestion, and AI valuation systems
  • Partner with the Data team on financial reporting, reconciliation validation, and KPI consistency
  • Align with shared infrastructure standards including observability, deployment, security, and API governance
  • Actively participate in architecture discussions to prevent payment systems from becoming isolated silos


Payment infrastructure must operate as part of the broader platform, not adjacent to it.


Banking & Financial Partner Integration

  • Own integrations with banking partners and payment rails including ACH, EFT, and lockbox flows
  • Ensure client onboarding for Treasury Accounts and payment configuration is scalable and repeatable
  • Evaluate and integrate banking-as-a-service platforms and financial data providers
  • Maintain compliance with NACHA rules, treasury controls, and internal financial policies


Team Leadership & Engineering Standards

  • Hire and build a payments-focused engineering pod consisting of 2 to 3 engineers within 12 to 18 months
  • Define engineering standards for reliability, testing, deployment, and incident response
  • Establish operational playbooks for payment-critical systems
  • Partner closely with Payment Operations to ensure systems support real-world workflows
  • Balance hands-on contribution with leadership and long-term architectural planning


What This Role Is Not:

  • Not a purely operational finance role
  • Not a detached architecture-only leadership position
  • Not a payments API integration wrapper role


This is a systems-level ownership role where financial correctness, reliability, and architectural clarity are primary responsibilities.


What Success Looks Like:

  • All money movement is reliable, traceable, and auditable
  • Settlement logic is automated and predictable
  • Reconciliation discrepancies are rare and surfaced early
  • Banking integrations are standardized and repeatable
  • Payment-critical incidents decrease over time
  • Cross-team dependencies are clear and well-managed
  • A high-performing payments pod operates with strong engineering discipline


Ideal Background:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • 3+ years building payment systems, financial infrastructure, or money movement platforms
  • Deep knowledge of ACH including NACHA rules, R-codes, batch construction, and prefunding
  • Experience designing ledger systems or reconciliation engines
  • Strong backend engineering experience including Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience operating payment-critical systems in production
  • Prior experience hiring or leading small engineering teams
  • Prior experience working at Nubank or in similar fintech companies


Strengths We Value:

  • Precision and rigor in financial system design
  • Systems thinking across multi-party money flows
  • Strong reliability mindset including observability, incident response, and recovery design
  • Clear, structured communication across engineering and finance stakeholders
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity while building durable architecture
  • High ownership and accountability


Why This Role Matters:

At our partner, money movement is core infrastructure, not an auxiliary capability.


Every advance, sweep, settlement, and reconciliation must be correct. As they scale into

hundreds of millions in annual volume, small architectural weaknesses compound into material financial risk.


This role ensures:

  • They scale financial infrastructure responsibly
  • They maintain trust with lab clients and banking partners
  • They prevent operational fragility as complexity grows
  • They build a durable foundation for future financial products


The Engineering Manager, Payments & Financial Infrastructure will help ensure that as they grow, their financial systems remain precise, resilient, and strategically aligned with the broader platform.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.

title: Correção de Redação
description:
A Filadd é uma edtech internacional, presente no cotidiano de mais de 2.000.000 de estudantes no Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia e Chile rumo ao ingresso na universidade. No Brasil, oferecemos aos nossos orientandos e orientandas um acompanhamento pedagógico de alta personalização para que se preparem para o ENEM e os Vestibulares de forma inteligente, através de trajetórias de aprendizagem individualizadas. Somos conhecidos como o cursinho online mais presencial do país!


Perfil da Equipe Filadd


● Diversidade: Todes são bem-vindes!

● Esta vaga é aberta a todas as pessoas. Encorajamos fortemente a candidatura de pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ e de pessoas pretas, pardas e indígenas. Respeito e acolhimento a todas as diversidades fundamentam os nossos valores.

● Visão inclusiva da Educação.

● Autonomia, flexibilidade e capacidade de aprendizagem.

● Empatia, escuta ativa, comunicação assertiva, respeitosa e inclusiva.

● Familiaridade com tecnologias digitais e de trabalho remoto.

● Respeito, gentileza e cordialidade sempre, para com todas as pessoas.


Requisitos e qualificações para a posição


● Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência no Pré-Vestibular, como professora | professor | plantonista de Redação ou como pessoa corretora de Redação nos modelos ENEM e Vestibulares Estaduais. Esta experiência é imprescindível .

● Disponibilidade de 4 horas ou mais, por dia, de segunda a sexta. Esta disponibilidade é também imprescindível.

● Graduação em Letras.

● Identificação com o perfil da Equipe Filadd;

● Familiaridade com as ferramentas de trabalho do Google Workspace;

● Boa comunicação e domínio da Língua Portuguesa, na escrita e na oralidade;

● Conhecimento sobre o ENEM, os Vestibulares e as Universidades brasileiras.


Serão diferenciais para esta posição:


● Experiências de correção junto a bancas oficiais de Vestibulares.

● Conhecimentos em Metodologias de Aprendizagem Ativa e Educação Socioemocional.

● Conhecimentos sobre a Linguagem Inclusiva.

● Cursos de pós-graduação e outras formações em Educação.

● Disponibilidade superior a 4 horas por dia, de segunda a sexta.


O que esperamos para esta posição?


Estudantes da Filadd contam com um acompanhamento individual por parte da Equipe de Redação, no desenvolvimento de sua autoria e autonomia na escrita de acordo com a nossa abordagem metodológica, para que possam escrever qualquer tipo de texto para as bancas do ENEM e Vestibulares sem que dependam de modelos prontos de redação.

Para isto, oferecemos os serviços de Mentoria de Redação e de Correção de Redação. Esta correção, diferente das correções de banca, é uma correção pedagógica, com o objetivo de apontar com clareza ao estudante todos os aspectos que deve desenvolver no seu texto. Os dois serviços estão fundamentalmente conectados, partilhando o objetivo de desenvolver a escrita do estudante.

Você integrará a equipe como pessoa Corretora de Redação, e estará em contato constante com a Coordenação Pedagógica do curso. Ao iniciar suas atividades conosco, você passará por um processo formativo completo e terá todo o suporte de que precisar.

O trabalho será realizado de forma 100% remota, e sua jornada será flexível, segundo os horários que você disponibilizar. A contratação será via PJ, com remuneração de acordo com as horas trabalhadas, com proposta de bônus por produtividade em relação às suas entregas.


Como se candidatar?


● IMPORTANTE : Envie seu currículo para .

● Não será aceita somente a candidatura simplificada via LinkedIn. Envie-a necessariamente por email .

● Coloque necessariamente no assunto: Processo Seletivo - Equipe Correção de Redação

● Não envie seu currículo Lattes.

● Inclua no corpo do texto a sua disponibilidade semanal.


Sua candidatura será muito bem-vinda!

Te aguardamos!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Enterprise Account Manager — HR Technology (LATAM)
description:
About Cadient


Cadient Talent is an AI-enabled hiring platform helping large employers attract, hire, and retain hourly and distributed workforces at scale. Our platform combines ATS technology, automation, and AI-driven recruiting workflows to help organizations:

  • Reduce time-to-hire
  • Increase applicant conversion
  • Improve hiring outcomes for high-volume workforces


Cadient serves enterprise employers across industries including healthcare, hospitality, retail, and service businesses. We are building the next generation of AI-powered hiring infrastructure used by some of the largest hiring organizations in the United States.


The Role

We are hiring an Enterprise Account Manager based in Latin America to manage and grow relationships with US-based enterprise clients. You will act as the primary relationship owner for HR and Talent Acquisition leaders, ensuring they achieve measurable hiring results using the Cadient platform. This role is responsible for client retention, revenue expansion, and strategic account management. You will operate as a trusted advisor, helping clients optimize hiring performance while identifying opportunities to expand their use of Cadient solutions.


Key Responsibilities


Own Client Relationships

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customer accounts in the United States
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for HR and talent acquisition leaders
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) analyzing hiring performance and platform usage
  • Ensure strong platform adoption, satisfaction, and measurable outcomes
  • Monitor client health signals and proactively resolve risks


Drive Revenue Expansion

  • Identify opportunities to expand platform usage and services
  • Drive renewals, upsells, and cross-sells
  • Build expansion pipelines within existing accounts
  • Work closely with sales leadership on strategic account growth


Coordinate Across Teams

  • Partner with product, support, and implementation teams
  • Ensure issues are resolved quickly and professionally
  • Bring customer insights back to internal teams to improve product and service delivery


What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3–6 years experience in account management, customer success, or SaaS client management
  • Experience working with US-based customers
  • Fluent English communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple client relationships simultaneously
  • Comfortable discussing business outcomes, ROI, and performance metrics
  • Experience working remotely across US time zones


Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, SaaS, or recruiting platforms
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Workday, iCIMS, UKG, Paradox, or similar
  • Experience working with enterprise HR or talent acquisition teams
  • Experience supporting high-volume hiring industries
  • Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.


What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Strong platform adoption and client satisfaction
  • Consistent upsell and expansion opportunities
  • Clear communication of account risks and opportunities
  • Strong internal collaboration with sales, product, and support teams


What You'll Be Responsible For in the First 90 Days

  • Build relationships with 20–40 active US client accounts
  • Conduct your first client performance and strategy reviews
  • Identify 3–5 expansion opportunities within existing accounts
  • Develop strong working relationships with internal product and support teams
  • Gain deep familiarity with Cadient’s hiring platform and workflows


This Role Is NOT a Fit If

  • You are looking for an entry-level customer support role
  • You are uncomfortable owning revenue retention and upsells
  • You prefer task execution instead of client-facing strategy
  • You are not comfortable speaking directly with US enterprise clients in English


Why Join Cadient

  • Work with a growing HR technology company serving large US employers
  • Be part of the AI transformation of hiring
  • Fully remote role based in Latin America
  • Exposure to enterprise HR leaders and large-scale hiring operations
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based upside


Application Note

When applying, please include a short paragraph answering the following question:

What is one thing most SaaS companies do wrong in customer success?


Applications without this answer may not be considered!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Data Analyst V
description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:

We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

  • Lead end-to-end LMS implementations, enhancements, and platform optimizations

This role is suited to professionals with early experience in LMS administration, system configuration, or SaaS implementation who are looking to develop into a senior consulting career path.


Full training will be provided on Cornerstone OnDemand and other enterprise LMS platforms. We welcome candidates with experience across a range of LMS systems or related SaaS platforms.


You will work closely with senior consultants to configure systems, support clients, and contribute to successful implementation outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Requirements

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.

  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)

  • Competitive compensation

Don’t meet every single requirement?

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

Sobre a Ótima Energia

Não somos apenas mais uma corretora de energia empurrando uma única solução. Na Ótima Energia, existimos para trazer clareza e confiança a um mercado confuso. As empresas brasileiras pagam caro pela energia não porque faltam opções, mas porque o mercado é barulhento: ofertas confusas, contratos ambíguos e vendedores empurrando o que paga a melhor comissão para eles.


Nós substituímos isso por uma abordagem neutra e baseada em dados. Nosso sistema de IA, o ECOS™, analisa os três mercados de energia (ACR, ACL, GDL) e diz às empresas exatamente onde elas economizarão mais, com zero conflito de interesses.


Nossa promessa: Sua energia. Sua escolha. Sua economia.  Estamos crescendo rápido. E precisamos de pessoas que amam vencer.


A Função: Closer (Consultor de Energia)

Este não é um trabalho para quem precisa que as coisas sejam fáceis. Este é um lugar para quem:

  • É um talento de alto potencial finalmente pronto para ser liberado.
  • Tem habilidade comprovada e busca o palco à altura da sua ambição.
  • Sabe o que é ralar e quer ralar por algo real.
  • Faz as pessoas se sentirem bem apenas por estarem no mesmo ambiente.
  • É um doador de energia, não um sugador.


Este Trabalho NÃO É Para Você Se:

  • Você trata a empatia como uma tática em vez de um traço de personalidade.
  • Você fala muito, mas tem zero disciplina para sustentar o que diz.
  • Você é uma \"pessoa de pessoas\", mas desmorona ao ser rejeitado.
  • Você ama o holofote, mas odeia a disciplina necessária para se manter nele.
  • Você está esperando por um \"golpe de sorte\" em vez de trabalhar mais que todos na sala.
  • Você tem \"100% de potencial\", mas só entrega 50% de esforço quando ninguém está olhando.


Quem Você É


Qualidade Por que isso importa


Você ama vencer | Fechar negócios traz uma sensação imbatível. Você é competitivo e acompanha seu placar.


Você é mentalmente forte | A rejeição não te abala. Você sabe que o \"não\" é apenas um número no caminho para o \"sim\".


Você é implacável | Você faz 60 ligações. Depois 80. Depois 100. Você não para até o trabalho estar feito.


Um charme natural | As pessoas genuinamente gostam de falar com você. Você cria conexão em segundos.


Esforço gera recompensa | Você entende que, aqui, resultados = recompensas financeiras.


Treinável, não robótico | Você domina o processo e o script, e depois os torna seus.


Disseram que você não seria capaz | E você ainda está aqui. Pronto para provar que estavam errados.


Fala Inglês | Básico ao avançado — o suficiente para entender documentos e falar com nosso fundador.


O Que Você Fará

  • Fazer de 60 a 100 ligações por dia para leads qualificados.
  • Ter conversas reais sobre economia de energia.
  • Explicar nossa abordagem neutra e sem conflito de interesses.
  • Lidar com objeções. Superar o \"não tenho interesse\". Transformar \"talvez\" em \"sim\".
  • Fechar negócios. E depois fechar mais.
  • Este é um jogo de volume. Os melhores closers fazem o maior número de ligações. É matemática pura.


O Dinheiro (É Bom)


Métrica | O que significa


Base Fixa | R$ 6.000,00 mensais.  Estabilidade garantida enquanto você constrói.


Comissão por negócio | Generosa. Sem teto. Receba pelo seu desempenho.

Sem Limites | Não travamos sua comissão. Quanto mais você vende, mais você ganha.


O Pacote

  • Contrato PJ: Você trabalha como pessoa jurídica. Simples, direto e profissional.
  • Equipamento: Fornecemos laptop + toda a tecnologia necessária. Sem custo para você.
  • Ferramentas: Zoho, Portal, sistema de leads — tudo configurado e pronto.
  • Treinamento: Completo sobre o mercado de energia, nosso processo e ferramentas.
  • Suporte: Você nunca será deixado sozinho para \"dar um jeito\".


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós

  • Ganhos ilimitados: Sua renda é limitada apenas pelo seu esforço e habilidade.
  • Oportunidade massiva: Milhares de leads qualificados esperando para serem chamados.
  • Produto real: Nós realmente ajudamos donos de empresas a economizar dinheiro.
  • Sem microgerenciamento: Confiamos no seu trabalho duro. Seus resultados falam por si.
  • Potencial de crescimento: Quem performa vira líder de equipe, gerente e depois diretor.
  • Um lugar para os subestimados: Se já duvidaram de você antes, você vai se sentir em casa aqui.

description:
Job Position

Commercial Executive

Line Manager:

Country Lead

About the Opportunity

OYO is seeking a dynamic and results-driven individual to take on the role of Commercial Executive , focusing on driving business development and fostering strong relationships with our property partners. This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for building and expanding our network of properties, maximizing revenue opportunities, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.


This Commercial Executive role offers an exciting opportunity to drive business growth, expand OYO's presence in key markets, and contribute to the success of our organization. If you are a motivated and entrepreneurial individual with a passion for business development and hospitality, we invite you to join our team and help us build the most trusted brand in the world.

En OYO buscamos a una persona dinámica y orientada a resultados para ocupar el puesto de Ejecutivo Comercial, centrado en impulsar el desarrollo de negocio y fortalecer las relaciones con nuestros socios propietarios de propiedades. Esta posición requiere de un pensador estratégico con pasión por construir y expandir nuestra red de propiedades, maximizando las oportunidades de ingresos y asegurando una satisfacción excepcional del cliente.


El rol de Ejecutivo Comercial ofrece una oportunidad emocionante para impulsar el crecimiento empresarial, expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave y contribuir al éxito de nuestra organización. Si eres una persona motivada y emprendedora con pasión por el desarrollo de negocios y la hospitalidad, te invitamos a unirte a nuestro equipo y ayudarnos a construir la marca más confiable del mundo.

Brief Job Description

As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.

Como Ejecutivo Comercial, jugarás un papel crucial en el impulso del crecimiento empresarial identificando y comprometiéndote con socios comerciales potenciales para expandir la presencia de OYO en mercados clave. Serás responsable de desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias para atraer nuevas propiedades, negociar acuerdos e impulsar la adopción del modelo OYO OS. Además, trabajarás estrechamente con los propietarios de propiedades para comprender sus necesidades, proporcionar apoyo continuo y asegurar un proceso de integración fluido.

Job Overview

The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.

El Ejecutivo Comercial se centrará en el desarrollo de negocios, incluyendo la prospección, generación de leads y construcción de asociaciones. Utilizarás tus fuertes habilidades de comunicación y negociación para cultivar relaciones con los propietarios de propiedades, impulsar la adopción de los productos y servicios de OYO y maximizar las oportunidades de ingresos. Además de expandir nuestra red de propiedades, también colaborarás con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades existentes.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pursue, and move leads through the sales cycle to expand OYO's network of properties in target markets.
  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans to achieve growth objectives.
  • Negotiate agreements with property owners to onboard new properties onto the OYO platform.
  • Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
  • Developing proposals for clients.
  • Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
  • Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
  • Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
  • Recovery of debt.
  • Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
  • Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.
  • Identificar, perseguir y avanzar leads a través del ciclo de ventas para expandir la red de propiedades de OYO en mercados objetivo.
  • Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de desarrollo de negocio para alcanzar objetivos de crecimiento.
  • Negociar acuerdos con propietarios de propiedades para integrar nuevas propiedades a la plataforma OYO.
  • Reunirse con clientes cara a cara o por teléfono.
  • Desarrollar propuestas para clientes.
  • Proporcionar apoyo continuo a los propietarios de propiedades, incluyendo asistencia con la integración, capacitación y solución de problemas.
  • Colaborar con equipos internos para desarrollar e implementar estrategias que optimicen el rendimiento de las propiedades y fomenten el crecimiento de ingresos.
  • Monitorear las tendencias del mercado y la actividad de los competidores para identificar oportunidades de expansión y diferenciación.
  • Coordinar estrategias de precios con los Gerentes de Ingresos.
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad de habitaciones (para venta) para la empresa.
  • Recuperación de deudas.
  • Prevención de deserción: Interactuar con socios para educarlos sobre las soluciones que OYO ofrece y reducir la deserción.
  • Experiencia del Socio: Asegurar el bienestar de nuestros socios es crítico y, por tanto, este rol es responsable de apoyar después de la integración para asegurar estándares de marca, entendimientos comerciales y actuar como función de apoyo para el socio.


Job Experience

2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.

2-3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de negocios, ventas o campos relacionados, preferiblemente en las industrias de Bienes Raíces y Hospitalidad.


Education

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.

Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Gestión Hotelera o campo relación


Language

Fluent in English (both verbal and written).

Inglés Fluido. Las entrevistas serán realizadas en Inglés.


Skills and qualifications

  • Drive and self-motivation.
  • Networking ability
  • Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving targets and delivering measurable results.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.
  • Automotivación.
  • Capacidad de establecer redes de contacto.
  • Fuertes habilidades de desarrollo de negocio con un historial probado de identificación y cierre de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación con la capacidad de construir y mantener relaciones con partes interesadas clave.
  • Pensador estratégico con la habilidad de analizar tendencias del mercado, identificar oportunidades y desarrollar planes de acción para impulsar el crecimiento.
  • Mentalidad orientada a resultados, con un enfoque en alcanzar objetivos y entregar resultados medibles.
  • Altamente organizado con fuertes habilidades de gestión de proyectos y la capacidad de priorizar y manejar múltiples tareas eficazmente.

title: Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist
description:
About ContentJet

ContentJet is a global creative production company specializing in high-performing UGC and creator-led ads for brands advertising on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


Our model combines a global network of creators, performance-driven creative strategy, and AI-assisted production systems to produce large volumes of social media content at scale.

As demand grows, we are expanding our global creator network and building one of the most efficient creator supply systems in the industry.


We are hiring a Head of Creator Partnerships & Expansion to lead this effort.


The Role

We are looking for a highly organized, internet-savvy Creator & Influencer Sourcing Specialist to serve as the tactical engine that keeps our creative projects moving. Your mission is to fill creator casting needs fast and accurately by turning client requirements into qualified, client-ready shortlists. You are the ultimate talent scout—spending your days hunting for the perfect creators, reaching out directly, and securing the right candidates for our campaigns.


What You Will Do

  • Creator Hunting & Sourcing: You will build structured sourcing plans to hunt for external creators across social platforms. You will use search signals and keywords to find niche talent quickly, rather than relying on luck.
  • Outbound Outreach & Pitching: You will execute high-volume outbound outreach via DMs and emails. You will clearly explain the project scope and requirements, pitching the opportunity to creators in a concise, persuasive way.
  • Negotiating & Confirming Terms: You will negotiate and confirm practical constraints with the creators, including their availability, delivery timelines, location, and usage rights terms.
  • Requirement Translation: You will turn messy client input into a crisp casting spec, identifying exact must-haves, lifestyle cues, and brand risk exclusions so you know exactly who to look for.
  • Upfront Quality Screening: You will protect quality upfront by validating a creator's audio/lighting viability, their on-camera tone and presence, and their ability to show products naturally.
  • Finding the Right Options (Shortlisting): You will build highly curated shortlist packs featuring 5-12 primary creator options that perfectly match the brief, packaging their links, bios, and performance vibes for client approval.


What You Won't Do

We believe in strict operational boundaries so you can focus entirely on talent discovery:

  • You stop at approval. Once your shortlist of creators is approved by the client, you hand off the execution to the Creative Fulfillment Specialist.
  • You do NOT own: formal contract execution, scheduling, shipping tracking, chasing deliverables, or paying the creators.


Skills & Experience Needed

  • 2+ years of concrete professional experience in influencer marketing, talent sourcing, creator casting, or a heavily outbound-focused outreach role.
