title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a Project Manage r to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and the internal team, ensuring expectation alignment, high‑quality delivery, and consistent communication. This professional will be responsible for leading projects end‑to‑end, ensuring that all deliverables are executed as planned while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Responsibilities

• Act as the central liaison between the client and the internal team, managing day‑to‑day communication and expectations.

• Own the project and all deliverables.

• Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with leadership and stakeholders.

• Develop project plans and communication documents, ensuring clarity and consistency.

• Estimate required resources and manage the project lifecycle using established methodologies.

• Create budget proposals, update financial forecasts based on SOW numbers, and propose adjustments when needed.

• Plan, schedule, and track project timelines, milestones, and resources, updating PSA Resource Forecasting weekly.

• Prepare and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations.

• Manage scope changes proactively, identify potential crises, and build contingency plans while documenting risks, blockers, and changes.

• Define success criteria and ensure alignment across all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

• Conduct project post‑mortems and produce recommendations highlighting successful and unsuccessful elements.

• Maintain a centralized blocker tracker for the client, including due dates, owners, and impacts.

• Use tools like Confluence to document meeting notes and ensure all project meetings and updates are recorded.

• Build and manage risk mitigation plans and handle escalations when required.

• Collaborate with QA to plan and execute project demos, ensuring all requirements are listed and completed before each sprint.

• Address internal team blockers and ensure all members have access to code, documentation, and essential resources.

• Send and review client status reports summarizing progress, budget updates, risks, changes, and action items.

• Understand cross‑platform and cross‑project dependencies, collaborating with other Project Managers in the program.

• Conduct weekly internal steerco meetings to review issues, risks, and planning alongside leadership and the Program Manager.

Requirements

• Direct experience in a project management role, including process development and execution.

• Strong familiarity with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Basecamp, or similar platforms.

• Solid working knowledge of IT technologies across a broad range of solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal and operational abilities.

• Ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast‑paced and high‑pressure environment.

• Hands‑on experience with project management practices and tooling to manage performance and deliverables.

• Proven ability to lead teams and drive projects to successful completion.

• Ability to lead development and implementation teams.

• Native Portuguese speaker.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field.

• PMP certification is a plus.

• Availability for travel, including onsite client meetings — primarily in São Paulo and Belo Horizonte.



Benefits

OSF offers a comprehensive package designed to support your well‑being, development, and professional growth:

• Meal or Food Vouchers

• Medical Assistance

• Dental Assistance

• Life Insurance

• Gympass

• Home Office/Education Assistance

Additional programs include:

• Training and development program

• Incentives for obtaining professional certifications (including Salesforce)

• Language program

• Professional referral program with bonuses


Diversity & Inclusion

OSF Digital is committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an environment where everyone can be their authentic selves. We value a diverse, inclusive, and engaged community of professionals dedicated to driving digital transformation worldwide.

We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind and ensure accessible processes, providing reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Analista de Negócios Digitais | Inovação em IA
description:
Sobre a Ionix

Ajudamos empresas a construir capacidade interna de IA de verdade. Nada de projeto que acaba na gaveta — a gente constrói processo, capacita o time e fica junto até o cliente andar sozinho.


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos alguém para atuar junto às áreas de negócio dos nossos clientes, identificando oportunidades e construindo soluções com IA e automação. Você vai ser o profissional que faz acontecer: mapeia processo, entende a dor, monta o protótipo, testa e documenta o aprendizado.

Não é consultoria de relatório. É mão na massa.


O que você vai fazer

Entrar nas áreas, conversar com as pessoas, entender como as coisas funcionam de verdade e onde dói.

Transformar essas dores em hipóteses claras: \"se a gente automatizar X, o resultado deve ser Y\".

Construir protótipos funcionais usando ferramentas como N8N, Lovable, Lindy, Make e similares. Ciclos curtos de 2-4 semanas.

Testar, medir, aprender. Funcionou? Escala. Não funcionou? Documenta o porquê e parte pra próxima.

Ensinar as pessoas das áreas enquanto trabalha junto. A ideia é deixar capacidade instalada, não criar dependência.

Alimentar o repositório de conhecimento com casos, templates e lições aprendidas.


O que você precisa ter

2-4 anos de experiência em funções que misturam tecnologia e negócio: analista de processos, analista de sistemas, consultor de transformação digital, product analyst ou algo parecido.

Saber usar ferramentas no-code/low-code. Se você já montou automação em N8N, Make ou Zapier, já prototipou em Lovable, Bubble ou Retool, está no caminho certo.

Conseguir escrever bons prompts para LLMs e entender o que dá pra fazer (e o que não dá) com IA generativa hoje.

Noção de API, banco de dados e integração. Não precisa ser dev, mas precisa conseguir fazer as coisas funcionarem e resolver pepino quando trava.

Saber conduzir conversa de discovery: perguntar certo, mapear processo, identificar gargalo, estimar impacto.

Comunicação boa. Você vai falar com gente de negócio e gente técnica no mesmo dia.

Autonomia. Você vai estar atuando remoto, muitas vezes resolvendo sozinho. Precisa saber tomar decisão.


Diferenciais

Ter algo pra mostrar. Um projeto pessoal, uma automação que você fez, um protótipo que rodou. Qualquer coisa que prove que você constrói.

Experiência com Lean Startup, Design Thinking ou Jobs-to-be-Done.

Inglês pra consumir documentação e acompanhar o que está saindo de novo.


O que você vai encontrar aqui

Projetos de transformação em IA com empresas grandes.

Exposição a áreas e setores diferentes — você não fica preso numa caixinha.

Mentoria de gente sênior em IA e produto.

Ambiente onde o que você constrói vira caso, e o que você aprende vira treinamento pra outros.

Trabalho 100% remoto.


Processo seletivo

  • Conversa inicial pra entender seu momento. Case prático pra ver como você pensa e resolve problema. Papo final com a liderança.

title: Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)
description:
Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)


100% Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados para atuar diretamente na migração e descomissionamento de sistemas SAP (ECC → S/4HANA) , apoiando o time de Engenharia e Arquitetura de Dados.


O profissional será responsável por executar atividades práticas de integração, mapeamento e migração de dados, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade em todo o processo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o processo de migração de dados entre os ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA.
  • Realizar o mapeamento de origens, transformações e regras de negócio utilizando SAP Data Services (DS) .
  • Conduzir análises de dados e validações de qualidade para garantir consistência e completude.
  • Executar atividades de integração com SAP SLT (fontes S/4) e DS (fontes ECC) .
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na construção de pipelines e processos de carga para o Data Lake (Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL) .
  • Documentar processos, tabelas e fluxos de dados, assegurando rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Apoiar a equipe no descomissionamento dos ambientes legados.


Atividades práticas do dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e ajustar jobs no SAP Data Services .
  • Mapear tabelas de origem SAP e relacionar com os destinos no ambiente cloud.
  • Criar documentação e planilhas de mapeamento e data lineage.
  • Fazer testes de extração, transformação e carga, acompanhando logs e performance.
  • Participar de checkpoints técnicos com equipe de Engenharia e Coordenação.
  • Apoiar análises de erros, inconsistências e ajustes nas integrações.


Experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com SAP Data Services (DS) e integrações SAP ECC / S/4HANA .
  • Conhecimento em integrações SLT e fluxos de replicação entre sistemas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de migração ou descomissionamento de sistemas SAP .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Databricks, Synapse ou Azure SQL .
  • Perfil hands on, analítico e proativo , com boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato (ASAP) .

title: Analista de TI Sênior (Administrador de Redes)
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.


Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes . Confira os detalhes abaixo:


FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA


  • Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
  • Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.


EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS


  • Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
  • Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
  • Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
  • Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).



MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO


Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.



BENEFÍCIOS


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio creche
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

title: Supervisor de Almoxarifado
description:
Descrição das atividades:

  • Controlar a entrada e saída de materiais no almoxarifado, manter controle do estoque mínimo, registrar movimentações em planilha na rede, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade de materiais necessários para eventuais emergências.
  • Manter registro de ferramentas de todos os colaboradores do setor e auditar periodicamente sem aviso prévio, para assegurar o controle, integridade e uso correto das ferramentas.
  • Solicitar pedido de compra mensal de materiais e ferramentas para reposição de estoque e reformas, através de controle do estoque e lista de matérias efetuadas e aprovadas para as reformas, para garantir disponibilidade de materiais necessários para a rotina de manutenção e reformas.
  • Organizar logística de ferramentas e materiais para as atividades diárias, através de planejamento verificar locais de atividades e materiais separados pelos colaboradores, para assegurar que as atividades sejam executadas com mínimo de perdas em deslocamento.
  • Efetuar inventários cíclicos e inventário geral das peças em estoque periodicamente, por meio da verificação física de cada item do almoxarifado, para que os registros do sistema estejam atualizados com físico.
  • Conferir notas fiscais dos materiais entregues e enviar para setor de compras, exigir ao fornecedor antes de receber os materiais a nota fiscal e após a conferência enviar em PDF ao setor de Compras, para controle de custos da manutenção.
  • Especificar e solicitar cadastros de novos materiais, consultando catálogos técnicos e fornecedores, preenchendo formulário e enviando para o setor de cadastro, para produtos não cadastrados e redução de custos com novos materiais.
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos de sua responsabilidade, efetuando limpeza após o uso, a fim de manter as regras de 5s, a fim de manter o ambiente saudável e seguro.
  • Zelar pela segurança na realização das atividades, utilizando os maquinários e ferramentas apropriadas para cada atividade, além dos EPI’s, para minimizar de riscos e prevenir acidentes de trabalho.
  • Treinar e orientar os almoxarifes da sua equipe.


Requisitos:

Experiência da área mínima de 5 anos;

Formação acadêmica em Logística e/ou áreas correlatas;

CNH B;

Pacote Office - intermediário;

Vivência com software de estoque.


Diferenciais:

Conhecimento software de programação TOTVS Protheus;

Facilidade com tecnologias e inovações;

Gostar de padronização.


Escala de Trabalho:

Segunda à sexta-feira - 8h às 17:48 (Joá, Barra da Tijuca | 100% presencial)


Remuneração:

Contratação CLT - Enviar pretensão salarial.

title: Bilingual Accounting Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: Remote Bilingual Accounting & Administrative Specialist


MasterPro Installs is seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Accounting & Administrative Specialist  to join our remote team. This role is ideal for professionals based in Brazil  who have experience with U.S. accounting standards , QuickBooks , and operational financial administration.

As we continue to grow across North America, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and can deliver accurate financial data, organized records, and strong administrative support  that help leadership make informed decisions.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Accounting & Finance

  • Manage daily accounting operations, including accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and send invoices  to clients and track collections
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations  and investigate discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate general ledger entries
  • Assist with budget preparation, financial forecasting, and cash flow tracking
  • Prepare monthly financial reports  and support year-end accounting processes
  • Conduct internal reviews of financial data  to ensure compliance and accuracy


Payroll & Financial Administration

  • Manage and process payroll preparation and payroll reports
  • Coordinate payroll data with external payroll providers when necessary
  • Maintain organized financial and payroll records
  • Track contractor payments and verify payment documentation
  • Assist with expense tracking and financial documentation


Administrative & Operational Support

  • Support financial documentation, contracts, and internal administrative processes
  • Maintain organized accounting files and digital records
  • Assist leadership with financial insights and operational reports
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure accurate billing and financial reporting


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • 3+ years of professional accounting or financial administration experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online and/or Desktop)
  • Practical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting processes
  • Strong Excel skills  (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, financial analysis)
  • Experience with invoicing, payroll coordination, and financial reconciliation
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment  while meeting deadlines


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based leadership team
  • Exposure to multi-state operations and international business
  • Growth potential within a rapidly expanding company


If you're an accounting professional in Brazil  with strong command of U.S. accounting standards and administrative finance operations , we’d love to hear from you.


 Apply now or send your CV and a brief introduction.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.

title: Vendedor Externo (Gestor de Negócios)
description:
VENDEDOR EXTERNO (GESTOR DE NEGÓCIOS) – COMERCIAL PJ


A Patrimonial Segurança é uma empresa especializada na proteção patrimonial, consolidada como referência no setor de segurança privada na região de Santa Catarina. title: Monitor (a) de Pesquisa Pleno - CRA II
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO


Gerenciar os centros de pesquisa de um determinado estudo e realizar monitoria dos centros de pesquisa do Brasil e/ou LATAM. Suporte aos monitores CRA I.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Realizar visitas de monitoria on-site ou remotas (visitas de seleção, iniciação, periódicas e encerramento) de acordo com o escopo de trabalho contratado e os requisitos regulatórios, ou seja, as diretrizes de Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e da Conferência Internacional de Harmonização (ICH).
  • Trabalhar com os centros para adaptar, impulsionar e rastrear o plano de recrutamento dos participantes de acordo com as necessidades do projeto para aumentar a previsibilidade.
  • Administrar protocolo e treinamento de estudo relacionado aos centros designados e estabelecer linhas regulares de comunicação com os centros para gerenciar expectativas e problemas contínuos do projeto.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e integridade das práticas do centro relacionadas à condução adequada do protocolo e adesão aos regulamentos aplicáveis. Escalar problemas de qualidade conforme apropriado.
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Certificar-se de que cópias/originais (conforme necessário) dos documentos do centro estejam disponíveis para arquivamento no TMF e verificar se o ISF é mantido de acordo com GCP/ICH e requisitos regulatórios locais.
  • Criar e manter documentação apropriada relativa ao gerenciamento do centro, monitorar resultados de visitas e planos de ação, enviando relatórios de monitoria, gerando cartas de acompanhamento e outra documentação de estudo necessária.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores.
  • Colaborar e estabelecer ligação com os membros da equipe de estudo para apoio à execução do projeto, conforme apropriado.
  • Se aplicável, ser responsável pela gestão financeira do centro.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA I, incluindo a realização de visitas de co-monitoria e treinamento.


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica

Graduação na Área da Saúde (Farmácia, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem, Biologia, Biomedicina, entre outras), pós-graduação na área preferencialmente, formação em pesquisa clínica


- Requisitos Técnicos:

Disponibilidade para viajar pelo menos 60% do tempo.


- Experiência:

Pelo menos 18 meses de experiência em pesquisa, experiência prévia em monitoria.


- Idiomas (Opcional):

Inglês: Avançado.

Espanhol necessário para monitores LATAM.


- Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Gerenciamento do tempo
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Coerência

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member’s ideas are valued.


LG Sonic Values : Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.


Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English .

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.


As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.


This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.


Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.


NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.


Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implantação | Ambientes (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Instalação de ambientes Containerizados;
  • Aplicação de GMUDs nos ambientes;
  • Participação em Certificação;
  • Instalação de ambientes on-premises;
  • Instalação de ambientes SaaS;
  • Validação de vulnerabilidades;
  • Suporte de ambiente ao time interno;
  • Instalação de KongConfiguração de Monitoração.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de tecnologia e correlatas
  • Experiência em Docker
  • Experiência com Containers
  • Experiência atuando com API Gateway (ex: Kong, APISix, Nginx)
  • Experiência com Orquestração Swarm


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Java;
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de autenticação e gestão de identidade como Ouath2 e/ou Keycloak;
  • Conhecimento em Apache e/ou Wildfly;
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de monitoramento como Grafana e/ou Kibana;
  • Conhecimento em Portainer e/ou Harbor;
  • Conhecimento em Vault;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.



O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft , and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
  • Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.
  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

title: Video Lead
description:
Impact3 - Video Lead

Join Impact3 – Help Us Change the Game in Crypto

Location: 100% Remote


How to Apply

  • Please submit a 2–3 minute Loom video highlighting your experience with video editing, including the tools you use, how you leverage AI, and your overall creative process. Be sure to attach your portfolio as well.


About Impact3

Impact3 is a growth marketing agency of crypto-native marketers dedicated to building trusted brands in the trustless technology space - aka crypto.

We specialize in social media management, public relations, paid advertising, visual production, strategy, go-to-market campaigns and more.


The Role

We don’t want just a \"Video Editor.\" We want a Video Architect. You should be someone who looks at a manual 20-hour editing task and finds a way to do it in 4 hours at a higher quality using your custom AI tech stack.

As the Video Lead at Impact3, you are the architect of our visual narrative. You don’t just \"edit video\", you build the engine that produces high-end, viral-ready content at the speed of the internet. You will lead a team of creators to transform complex crypto concepts into hyper-realistic, professional video assets.

This is a leadership role, but it is also hands-on. You must be comfortable leading a team while actively working inside Premiere Pro and After Effects yourself.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between \"standard social video\" and \"cinematic AI production,\" ensuring Impact3 remains the most innovative agency in the Web3 space.


  • Hyper-Realistic Storyboarding: Lead the pre-production process by using AI to generate high-fidelity, professional-grade storyboards that look like final frames. You will set the visual \"North Star\" for every project before a single second of video is rendered.
  • Production Leadership (Hands-On): Manage and mentor a team of video editors, ensuring all outputs meet \"Senior\" quality standards while maintaining an AI-first workflow. You must be capable of stepping in, solving technical challenges directly, and setting the creative and technical bar through execution.
  • End-to-End AI Integration: Own the process of incorporating generative AI (Video-to-Video, Text-to-Video, AI Voiceover, and Generative Audio) into the traditional post-production pipeline.
  • Process Architecture: Document and refine the \"Impact3 Video Playbook\"—creating scalable workflows that allow the team to pivot from TikTok/Reels to high-end brand films instantly.
  • Quality Control: Act as the final gatekeeper for visual polish, advanced motion graphics, color grading, and \"the vibe,\" ensuring everything is culturally relevant to the crypto audience.


Key Skills and Qualifications

  • Proficient English Level: You must be able to communicate complex creative visions and lead meetings in English fluently. This is non-negotiable.
  • Vast AI Knowledge: You must demonstrate a documented history of using AI tools (e.g., Runway, Pika, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) to solve production bottlenecks and elevate visual quality.
  • Capacity to Lead: You have experience managing creative teams, giving actionable feedback, setting standards, and taking ownership of deadlines.
  • Storyboarding Mastery: Ability to create professional, hyper-realistic boards that accurately represent lighting, composition, and movement.
  • Adobe Proficiency (Premiere + After Effects): You must be highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and advanced in After Effects. After Effects proficiency is mandatory for professional-grade motion graphics, compositing, and AI-integrated post-production workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Strength: You are not just a manager—you are capable of executing complex edits, building motion systems, and solving production challenges directly.
  • (Nice to have) Crypto-Native Fluency: Understanding \"Crypto Twitter\" culture, memes, and the visual language of Web3 is a major plus but not a dealbreaker if you are a fast learner.


How Our Team Works (Our Ethos)

  • We’re in this together: no silos, no egos; we support each other.
  • Take ownership: be accountable, act like an owner, go the extra mile.
  • Get shit done: move fast, focus on execution, learn by doing.
  • Simplify & systemize: build processes, document workflows, work smarter.
  • Lead by example: learn first, then teach and raise the bar.
  • Speak up: over-communicate, ask for help, share ideas openly.
  • Get obsessed: live the space, bring curiosity, chase excellence.


What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and challenging role in a rapidly evolving industry.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Remote work: our team spans Canada, USA, Mexico, Spain, Italy, Bulgaria, Albania, Macedonia, Romania, India, Portugal, Brazil, Argentina and more.
  • Annual retreat to build relationships and plan for growth.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Sênior - JavaScript/Node + AWS (com atuação em arquitetura e refinamento de requisitos)
description:
Sobre a InBot:

Somos uma empresa especializada em Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Desenvolvemos assistentes virtuais inteligentes que integram PLN (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), busca semântica e IA generativa, oferecendo experiências únicas para usuários e resultados práticos para nossos clientes.


Na InBot, você vai trabalhar com projetos que envolvem desde personagens digitais (como Mia, Ricardo, Fernando) até soluções robustas para grandes empresas e governos, usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar a comunicação entre pessoas e organizações.


Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.


Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.


Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.


Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.


Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.


Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.


Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.


Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento, essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:

AWS (EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, ACM, RDS)

APIs REST e JSON

Git (controle de código e versionamento)

Linux (administração e Shell)

Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados


Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais:

Tradução Negócio ↔ Técnica: Capacidade de entender rapidamente o contexto do cliente e transformar necessidades em soluções técnicas claras, alinhadas com prazos, riscos e impactos.


Senso de Dono e Pragmatismo: Foco em entregar valor com qualidade, escolhendo soluções sustentáveis e evitando complexidade desnecessária.


Organização e Comunicação Técnica: Saber conduzir refinamentos, registrar decisões e manter o time alinhado, garantindo transparência e clareza sobre escopo, riscos e dependências.


Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.

Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.

Comunicação: Clareza e objetividade ao se comunicar com clientes e equipe interna.

Senso de Lógica e Criatividade: Resolver problemas de forma analítica, criando soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Informações adicionais

Contrato PJ + cartão Flash.

Regime híbrido: presencial até 3x por semana no escritório (próximo à Av. Paulista).

Projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com tecnologia de ponta em IA conversacional.

  • Ambiente colaborativo, que valoriza autonomia, criatividade e foco em resultado.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:

  • Executar handover estruturado: garantir passagem com contexto, próximos passos, dores mapeadas e hipóteses validadas;

  • Acompanhar métricas do funil (resposta, conexão, reuniões, no-show, conversão por etapa) e propor experimentos com base em dados;
  • Atuar com boas práticas de conformidade (ex.: LGPD) na abordagem e registro de informações.


REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência prática com prospecção outbound e abordagem fria (especialmente cold calls);
  • Boa condução de pitch e conversa: saber abrir, gerar curiosidade, criar valor e fazer perguntas de diagnóstico;

  • Vivência prospectando decisores em operações (logística, e-commerce, supply, transporte, last mile);
  • Experiência com social selling (LinkedIn) e geração de demanda 1:1;
  • Noções de copywriting aplicado a outbound (dor, prova, objeções, CTA);
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de análise (planilhas, dashboards, leitura de funil e experimentos);
  • Experiência com WhatsApp como canal complementar (quando aplicável e com boas práticas).


BENEFÍCIOS:

DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .

  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

COMO SE DESTACAR:

  • Resultados de outbound : reuniões agendadas, taxa de resposta, taxa de conexão, conversão por etapa, volume semanal e consistência;

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Technical Recruiter Intern

  • Strong interest in technical recruiting, staffing, and the AI/automation industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.
  • Familiarity with Zoho applications or willingness to learn is a plus.
  • Interest in or experience using AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) is an advantage.

This is an unpaid internship designed as a professional development opportunity. While there is no monetary compensation, interns will receive valuable industry training, certifications, and reference letters to support their career growth.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.
