title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Senior Go Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Go Backend Integration Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design and build the systems that connect our core platform to third-party services, real-time messaging infrastructure, and internal data pipelines. You will work across engineering and product teams to define integration strategies that align with our Enterprise Architecture, contributing to both the technical execution and the long-term scalability of our systems.


What You'll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs in Go (Golang)
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms including CommerceTools, Constructor, and others
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of real-time messaging systems using Apache Kafka
  • Work with Postgres and SQL to model, query, and optimize relational data
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development to support automated builds, testing, and deployments
  • Collaborate with project teams to define requirements and integration strategies aligned with Enterprise Architecture standards


What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including 3–4+ years of professional Go (Golang) development
  • Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs from commercial software applications
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka or similar real-time event streaming platforms
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL in production environments
  • Familiarity with enterprise, systems, integration, and data architecture standards and frameworks
  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar
  • Fluent English (we communicate only in English)
  • Located in Europe
  • Be able to start full-time within 2 weeks


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience integrating with CommerceTools, Constructor, or similar commerce/search platforms
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience working within an enterprise architecture governance model
  • Background in e-commerce, retail tech, or marketplace platforms

Trabalho 100% presencial no RJ.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de \"security by design\". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário

Day Off no mês de Aniversário

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de \"security by design\". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role manages supplier follow-up after order placement, covering production stages, fabrics, price negotiations, and replenishment orders. It requires close collaboration with suppliers to ensure alignment with SHEIN processes, assess capacity, and support continuous improvements. Strong communication skills and experience working with spreadsheets and data-driven processes are essential.


Responsabilities:

  • Coordinate with designers on new product development, manage monthly first production orders, and ensure sufficient new SKCs for design updates.
  • Manage relationships with assigned garment suppliers, ensure on-time bulk order delivery, and support issue resolution throughout the production process.
  • Support the hunting team in meeting ESG requirements by driving supplier remediation and improving ESG ratings.
  • Analyze production and performance data to help suppliers improve capacity, quality, and delivery timeliness.
  • Establish, optimize, and maintain bulk order operational standards, including system SOPs, and deliver training to order coordinators and suppliers.
  • Continuously improve supply chain processes by identifying optimization opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve lead times.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the apparel industry.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong understanding of garment production processes across all categories, with the ability to resolve production issues.
  • Excellent data analysis skills with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills to drive improvements in delivery performance, quality, and cost efficiency.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: SAP S/4 HANA Application Architect - Product Management (Arquitecto de aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA - Gestión de productos) - End-user Support/Consultant
description:

  • Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.

  • Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.

Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP MM.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in US/APC time zone as well for the need basis.

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

title: Data Architect (Database Administration & Optimization)
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a part-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will work across a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. Daily tasks include optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, communicating campaign progress, and staying current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance. Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to , Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can take ownership of campaign performance. This includes a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. This person must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid digital marketing campaigns
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • 2+ years of e-commerce experience


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

15–20 hours per week. Remote. Ability to work during Eastern Time is required.


Pay

$25–$32 USD per hour, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Go Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Go Backend Integration Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You will work across engineering and product teams to define integration strategies that align with our Enterprise Architecture, contributing to both the technical execution and the long-term scalability of our systems.

  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms including CommerceTools, Constructor, and others

  • Work with Postgres and SQL to model, query, and optimize relational data
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development to support automated builds, testing, and deployments
  • Collaborate with project teams to define requirements and integration strategies aligned with Enterprise Architecture standards


What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including 3–4+ years of professional Go (Golang) development
  • Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs from commercial software applications
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka or similar real-time event streaming platforms
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL in production environments
  • Familiarity with enterprise, systems, integration, and data architecture standards and frameworks
  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar
  • Fluent English (we communicate only in English)
  • Located in Europe
  • Be able to start full-time within 2 weeks


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience integrating with CommerceTools, Constructor, or similar commerce/search platforms
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience working within an enterprise architecture governance model
  • Background in e-commerce, retail tech, or marketplace platforms

title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer
description:

The role is backend-first, with a strong focus on AI architecture, integration, and implementation. Frontend exposure is helpful but not the primary focus.

  • Design and build AI-native applications leveraging LLMs and agentic frameworks
  • Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector store integrations

  • Develop and scale RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
  • Build modern AI applications using Python (primary) and TypeScript
  • Integrate backend systems using Python or Go
  • Design and manage data systems using Postgres and Redis

  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate logistics, monetization, and operational requirements into scalable technical systems

Required Skills


Programming & Backend Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend development and AI model integration
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Extensive experience designing, scaling, and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Deep understanding of Postgres and Redis
  • Experience building production-grade systems


AI-Native & Agentic Development

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI principles and autonomous system design
  • Experience working with LLMs and generative AI tooling
  • Practical experience with:
  • RAG architectures
  • Vector databases and embeddings
  • Semantic search
  • Dynamic reasoning and task planning workflows


Cloud & Systems

  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles
  • Comfortable working across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Cloud-agnostic competency (AWS experience is beneficial but not mandatory)


Observability & Tooling (Preferred)

  • Experience with AI observability platforms such as LangSmith or similar tools

General & Soft Skills

  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices

  • Exceptional problem-solving ability
  • High ownership mindset — able to independently drive initiatives from concept to deployment
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong product intuition and ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes

What Success Looks Like

  • You independently design and ship scalable, production-ready AI systems
  • You proactively identify architectural improvements and performance optimizations
  • You translate business challenges into intelligent, automated workflows
  • You contribute to building a strong AI-native engineering culture

title: Sales Account Executive (Closer)
description:
About Us


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We work alongside ambitious SaaS teams as long-term design partners, helping translate complex challenges into meaningful user experiences that support real business growth.


Our approach is embedded, focused on partnership and outcomes, rather than transactions. While UX/UI is at our core, we support everything design-related — from product and web to motion, graphic design, and branding.


About the Role


We’re looking for a high-ownership, consultative Account Executive to drive new business for Foundey. This is an end-to-end sales role where you’ll own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through discovery, strategic alignment, proposal development, and close. You’ll work directly with founders, product leaders, and engineering executives at fast-growing SaaS and AI companies.


Success in this role requires strong discovery skills, the ability to diagnose product and growth challenges, and comfort selling high-value design engagements. This is not a transactional sales motion. It requires both commercial sharpness and genuine empathy — someone who listens deeply, understands a founder’s context and constraints, and builds trust through thoughtful, consultative conversations, not just pressure-driven tactics.


What You’ll Do


  • Own and close B2B SaaS deals end-to-end, working with cutting edge startups to Series A/B organizations
  • Generate outbound pipeline and build opportunities from scratch
  • Sell SaaS, technology solutions, or tech-enabled services (especially UX/UI, but also graphic, web and motion design services)
  • Lead strategic discovery calls with senior decision-makers
  • Run compelling discovery calls and live working sessions, along with delivering executive-level presentations
  • Multi-thread deals across stakeholders
  • Drive negotiations with confidence
  • Maintain disciplined forecasting and deal control
  • Consistently exceed aggressive revenue quotas


What We’re Looking For


  • Minimum 3+ years of B2B sales experience
  • Strong experience closing enterprise SaaS and/or Technology Solutions ○ Bonus: UX/UI service deals
  • Proven, documented track record of exceeding quota
  • Experience selling to startups and scale-ups, especially within North America
  • Deep understanding of selling technology to product-driven companies
  • Native or fluent English (mandatory)
  • Exceptional closing, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
  • Executive presence and strong communication
  • Highly competitive, resilient, and performance-driven
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and early-stage environments
  • High ownership mindset with a drive to create impact


Must-haves


  • You have demonstrated closing opportunities from end-to-end
  • Take full ownership of achieving your quarterly quota / goals
  • You thrive in a high pace environment
  • Demonstrated the ability to close multi-threaded deals
  • Ability to work with multiple Buyer Personas - Founders, CEOs, CIO/CTO, VP of Engineering
  • Nice to Have - worked in a startup environment


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description: About Turing:Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de Loja | Casa Shopping Barra da Tijuca RJ
description: Sobre a ZissouA Zissou nasceu com o propósito de redefinir a relação das pessoas com o sono, unindo produtos inovadores e foco total na experiência. Tudo é pensado para transformar a rotina de quem escolhe a marca, com sensibilidade para entender as necessidades de cada cliente e transformar a conversa em uma oportunidade real de conexão e venda. Sobre a vaga Procuramos um(a) Gerente de Loja para assumir a liderança da Zissou no Casa Shopping. Esta é a nossa primeira loja fora de São Paulo e representa um passo importante no nosso plano de expansão. Queremos alguém que construa essa história junto com a gente. Você será responsável por coordenar toda a rotina da loja, incluindo os processos administrativos (ponto, escalas, folgas), condução da equipe e acompanhamento de indicadores. Também terá papel essencial no desenvolvimento do time, na excelência do atendimento e na performance comercial. Principais responsabilidades Coordenar, acompanhar e orientar a equipe de vendas com foco em resultado e excelência no atendimento. Realizar a gestão administrativa da loja: controle de ponto, escalas, folgas, horas extras e processos operacionais. Gerenciar a operação como um todo: pessoas, produtos, processos, estoque , VM e performance. Realizar o recrutamento e seleção de novos talentos da loja, junto ao time de RH. Acompanhar metas, indicadores e resultados, buscando consistentemente a superação dos objetivos mensais. Atuar como embaixador(a) da Zissou, garantindo que os valores da marca estejam presentes no dia a dia da operação. Antecipar desejos e necessidades dos clientes, criando ações de impacto e conexão com o público. Promover um ambiente positivo e colaborativo, valorizando o time e fortalecendo a Cultura Zissou. Requisitos Vivência com artigos de luxo ou de alto valor agregado. Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento. Habilidade em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipe. Capacidade de tomada de decisão com autonomia e responsabilidade. Visão analítica para indicadores e performance comercial. Facilidade com pacote Office e ferramentas do Google. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal. Flexibilidade de horário e disponibilidade. Diferenciais que contam pontos Experiência comprovada como gerente ou líder no varejo (colchões, enxovais, móveis ou similares). Vivência com CRM ou ativações locais. Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e personalizadas. Jornada e escala Funcionamento da loja: das 10h às 20h, de segunda a domingo Escala de trabalho: 6x1 Benefícios Comissão sobre vendas (de acordo com política interna) Assistência médica 100% custeada para titular Assistência odontológica (opcional com valor subsidiado) Vale-refeição via Flash (restaurantes ou mercados) Vale-transporte via Flash (sem desconto em folha) Seguro de vida Total Pass Empréstimo consignado Consultoria financeira e jurídica (C4Life) Plataforma de saúde (Clude) Convênio com o Sesc Desconto em produtos Zissou

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description: About YouYou are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization. You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions. This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months, with the possibility of extension. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS. Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code. Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows. Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services. Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing. Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity. Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization. Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders. Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have). You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning. Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS. Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability. Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability. Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader. Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards. Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency. Qualifications 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code. Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services). Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments. Conversational English (B2+). Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description: Código da Vaga: 58095 Sobre a BRQ Digital Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!- O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!Responsabilidades: Experiência em .NET Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços; Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.); Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria; Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança, Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes); Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.- O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares: Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos. Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede. Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.- E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!- Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutionsCurtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Coordenador(a) de Controle de Qualidade
description: Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil!Para o nosso time, buscamos pessoas protagonistas e dispostas a inovar, atuando como agentes transformadores em prol do nosso objetivo. Alinhado ao nosso DNA, queremos promover um ambiente de trabalho sustentável, desenvolvedor e seguro. Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro – RJ (Presencial)Responsabilidades e atribuições: Participar da elaboração do plano anual das atividades relacionadas com o sistema de gestão da qualidade, coordenar o levantamento e análise dos procedimentos existentes; Coordenar, planejar e acompanhar os serviços voltados para avaliar a qualidade da água tratada e distribuída, bem como do efluente das estações de tratamento de esgoto, por meio de análises laboratoriais; Coordenar a área sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a correta administração de recursos financeiros, administrativos e de pessoal; Dirigir veículos da empresa em caso de necessidade de serviço externo, zelando pela segurança e normas de trânsito estabelecidas. Promover o atendimento e cumprimento das normas e procedimentos Sustentabilidade (Qualidade, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde).Requisitos e qualificações: Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Ambiental; CNH categoria B definitiva e válida; Experiência com controle de qualidade; Experiência com gestão laboratorial; Experiência com liderança de equipe; Experiência com gestão orçamentária; Domínio no Pacote Office.Requisitos Desejáveis CRQ e/ou CREA ativo; Conhecimento da Norma ISO 9001 e 17025; Conhecimento no sistema LIMS e SAP; Entendimento de tratamento de água e esgoto; Desejável conhecimento no PNQS; Experiência no segmento do saneamento (água e esgoto).Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PCD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!O que oferecemos: Salário compatível com o mercado; Seguro de Vida; Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes; Plano odontológico extensivo aos dependentes; Vale alimentação/Refeição; Total Pass; Rede de benefícios e descontos; Serviço de telemedicina; PLR.

title: Key Account Manager
description: En Iquall Networks somos una empresa global que desarrolla soluciones de automatización para las redes de telecomunicaciones más importantes del mundo. Buscamos un/a Key Account Manager en Río de Janeiro, Brasil, con visión, energía y capacidad de ejecución para ayudarnos a seguir creciendo.Queremos personas con iniciativa, criterio y autonomía; capaces de involucrarse, escuchar al cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y trabajar codo con codo con nuestros equipos técnicos para generar oportunidades reales.No importa si no tienes diez años de experiencia: lo que más valoramos es tu actitud, tu forma de pensar y tus ganas de marcar la diferencia. Eso sí, necesitamos que cuentes con experiencia previa en entornos comerciales o tecnológicos.¿Qué harás?- Ser el punto de contacto principal entre Iquall y los operadores de telecomunicaciones. - Acompañar el ciclo comercial completo: desde la detección y generación de oportunidades hasta el seguimiento postventa. - Participar activamente en la elaboración de propuestas, respuestas a RFPs y presentaciones de alto impacto. - Coordinar reuniones con distintas áreas del cliente (Tecnología, Operaciones, Compras, B2B, etc.). - Construir relaciones de largo plazo, basadas en la confianza y un entendimiento profundo del negocio. - Identificar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con nuestros equipos de producto, preventa y delivery. - Aportar ideas y opiniones sobre estrategia comercial y condiciones.Qué buscamos en ti- Experiencia previa en áreas comerciales, técnicas o consultivas dentro del sector Telco o tecnológico. - Capacidad de autogestión y autonomía: aquí nadie te va a empujar; necesitamos que tomes la iniciativa. - Ganas de aprender rápido, colaborar intensamente y asumir retos variados. - Claridad para comunicar ideas complejas a distintos perfiles de interlocutores. - Espíritu colaborativo: no trabajas solo/a, trabajas con un equipo que te respalda. - Inglés imprescindible. - Buen criterio, inteligencia práctica y pasión por resolver problemas reales.Qué ofrecemos- Formar parte de una empresa ágil, global y en pleno crecimiento. - Acceso a proyectos con los principales operadores del mercado. - Un entorno que valora las ideas nuevas, el compromiso y la capacidad de ejecución. - Modalidad 100% remota, con flexibilidad y autonomía. - Espacios reales para aprender, aportar y desarrollarte profesionalmente.Si te ves reflejado/a en esta propuesta y quieres trabajar con impacto real en el futuro de las telecomunicaciones, escríbenos.Queremos conocerte.

title: Service Engineer
description: Job Summary:The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.In this role, your responsibilities will be: Onboard Service Execution: Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters. Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations. Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution: Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products. Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials. Reports / Administrative Activities: Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points. Onboard service reports must be signed by customers. Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner. Participation in FAT Tests: Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class. Training: Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson. Participate in, observe, and comply with the company's health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment. Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates. Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.Who You Are: You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.For this role, you will need: Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus. 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment. Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments. Availability to work overtime, as needed. Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel. Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Work location: Rio de Janeiro.Our Culture and Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description: Estamos em busca de umCoordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TIque será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio. Seus desafios serão:Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia. Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS). Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT). Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes. Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos. Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
